title: Aren and Yara skill animations rebuilt on captured glaive and staff motion, with flowing combos
coordinator: main session; no independent external reviewer; no subagents
problem: Aren's and Yara's skills were cut from unrelated takes: sports/utility presets, then generic empty-handed Mixamo sword and spell takes. Poses did not read as a glaive warrior or a staff sorceress, limbs and weapon passed through the body, and each combo step started from an unrelated pose, so a chained combo snapped instead of flowing.
method: Every skill is a Viggle/PINOC text-to-motion take generated for this hero and weapon (asset-source/viggle, ledger provenance.json: 29 requests, 97 credits, 17 samples kept) on the 65-joint Mixamo rig, played in place. Each combo is one continuous take cut at its quiet instants, every step ending on the pose the next starts from; charge loops and their releases are one take (or a seamFrom blend), so a release opens on the loop pose. Keyed warps land each blow's fastest hand motion on the simulation hit tick; the glaive follows the striking forearm frame by frame, the sigil clips aim it level. Yara keeps her staff arm layer (both fists on the staff for the slams and the aim, raised in front of the face), limitLean, clearArms and staffClearance.

verification.playedThroughHeroPreview: aren-skills.webp and yara-skills.webp: every skill clip rendered through mountHeroPreview (the Skills tab path) at game speed (clipSlowdown 1.5); rows = clips, columns = time.
verification.comboSeams: Largest joint rotation between a step's last frame and the next step's first frame: 0.0 deg for Aren light 1->2->3->4, Yara thornshot 1->2->3, and every charge -> release pair (Thunder Cleave, Sigil Bolt/Barrage, Root Eruption, Sap Lance, Seed Storm).
verification.game: Greenwake trial, debug page exposing the running app: Aren J x4 inside the chain window played aren-light-1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 (aren-combo-ingame.webp); Yara J x3 played thornshot-1 -> 2 -> 3 (yara-combo-ingame.webp); held K -> root-charge -> root-eruption, held L -> seed-charge -> seed-storm, tapped L -> sap-lance, all with their VFX.
verification.meshAudit: audit-after.json (scripts/assets/audit-hero-mesh-intersection.mjs yara aren --corrected): over the 26 Aren/Yara skill and evasion clips mean buried vertices 1067 -> 34 against the clips before #134 (76 without the runtime solver).
verification.tests: aren-native-animation + aren-clip-sim-timing 58 pass, 2 failures that also fail on main (byte-identical rebuild under bun, ActorAnimationDriver monster clip); attack-posture, hero-limb-clearance, yara-anatomy, yara-knockdown-getup, LimbClearance and heartroot-skills 44 pass.

vfx: Yara's hand casts (Thornshot 1-3, Binding Vines, Cleanse) are cast by her left hand in the new takes; the launch flare, sap trail and drawn thorn/seed start at the left palm (ActorBounds.leftPalm) and ease onto the simulated path within 0.15 s. Seed Storm's seeds leave the raised staff head. Presentation only.
limits: Aren's Thunder Cleave release and Heavy keep the deepest remaining overlaps: up to 51 and 23 buried vertices on one frame with the runtime solver (the two-handed overhead slam brings the upper arms against the head).
Aren's back handspring and second jump (aren-air-step) and Yara's air step were not re-authored.
The in-game camera shows the hero small; the contact sheets (HeroPreview path) are the close inspection.
